summary: NORPRO AS (org. no. 986 142 444) is a private limited company (AS) based in Stor-Elvdal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2003-10-16. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.520 (Detaljhandel med jernvarer, byggevarer, fargevarer og glass); it has 7 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 11.8 m and net income was NOK 1.6 m. CEO: Pinehas Austeng; board chair: Preben Henriksen; auditor: GUDBRANDSDAL REVISJON AS.
